ImageDescription.value:
Three generations on the LGA1700 socket are the result of AMD's competition, something that hasn't happened since LGA775. But is it worth taking the new refresh? What did Intel hide when it introduced the Core 14? We reveal all the nuances of the updated Raptor Lake.

Top processors Top graphics cards

00:00 - MC introduction 01:19 - History of the LGA1700. Intel Core 12th, 13th Gen 04:06 - Raptor Lake refresh theory 10:54 - Intel Core i9-14900K tests 16:45 - Intel Core i7-14700K tests 18:51 - Intel Core i5-14600K tests 19:41 - MC conclusions

Uploader's note: Intel's 14th Intel Core generation has been the subject of much criticism. On the one hand, the very low performance increase compared to the 13th generation was criticized, which can be leveled by overclocking the Intel Core i9-13900K. In addition, the 13th and 14th Intel Core CPUs are sometimes very unstable and have a real risk of irreversible damage during operation. Three generations on the LGA1700 socket are the result of AMD's competition, something that hasn't happened since LGA775. But is it worth taking the new refresh? What did Intel hide when it introduced the Core 14? We reveal all the nuances of the updated Raptor Lake.
